subject: MSA + Order Form: portal delegation & PO-ack SLA exceptions
messages:
From: Susan Miller <susan.miller@crescentmedical.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: ProcurePlus PMO <pmo@procureplus.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood MSA + Order Form — portal mapping + PO-ack SLA

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Crescent is ready to move forward but they need two items confirmed before we start Ariba registration: 1) Can Redwood accept our standard PO acknowledgement SLA (48 hours) as an exception for a scoped subset of orders? 2) Our portal team needs a clear field-to-field mapping between your Order Form and Ariba PO schema (especially remit/ship-to, invoice-to party IDs, and line-level unit of measure).

Attached is the Crescent procurement intake doc and an initial PO mapping template — the portal team asked for any legal exceptions in writing. Our procurement lead is copied (pmo@procureplus.com).

Can you confirm who on your team will sign off on the MSA redlines vs. operational mapping so we can schedule a quick triage?

Thanks,
Susan

--
Susan Miller
Head of Strategic Sourcing
Crescent Medical

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Susan Miller <susan.miller@crescentmedical.com>
Cc: ProcurePlus PMO <pmo@procureplus.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — portal mapping + PO-ack SLA

Hi Susan — thanks for the note and the files.

Quick answers up front:
- Legal redlines (MSA + Order Form) will be handled by our Contracts team (Kimberly is on-copy).
- Operational PO-field mapping and PO-ACK SLA / runtime behavior will be coordinated by our Activation/Onboarding team — I will lead the portal handoff.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly will provide a short redline response (MSA) with any mandatory non-starters by EOD 5/17.
2) I’ll run a mapping session with Crescent’s portal team and our integration engineer (30–45m) the morning of 5/18. Please confirm availability.
3) If Procurement needs a formal SLA exception (48h PO-ACK), Kimberly and I will document the exception in an amendment to the Order Form so it can be attached to the portal registration packet.

I’m attaching a preliminary redline and a field-mapping template filled with Redwood’s canonical names to speed the session.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Activation Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0168

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redline_20270514.docx; OrderForm-field-mapping-v1.xlsx

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Susan Miller <susan.miller@crescentmedical.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — portal mapping + PO-ack SLA

Hi Susan, Soojin —

Attached is our MSA + Order Form redline with commentary. High-level notes:
- We can accept a 48-hour PO-ACK SLA as an Order Form amendment limited to POs below $25k and for standard SKU-only orders (no custom integration work). We cannot accept a blanket 48h SLA for multi-vendor or EDI exceptions.
- We require the portal to surface invoice-to and remit-to by tax ID so our finance team can validate invoices programmatically.
- For auditing we need the portal to capture the originating PO XML payload (or a persistent reference link) for 365 days; if the portal cannot guarantee this, we’ll require an alternate routing for invoice ingestion.

Kimberly has inserted tracked comments in the Word doc; the key decision points I need from Crescent are: 1) scope of the 48h exception (e.g., dollar threshold and SKU list) and 2) confirmation portal can persist PO payloads for 365 days.

If both are agreeable we’ll draft a one-page amendment that Crescent can sign electronically — Marissa will own the DocuSign and activation checklist.

Cheers,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_redline_20270514.docx

From: ProcurePlus PMO <pmo@procureplus.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Miller <susan.miller@crescentmedical.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — portal mapping + PO-ack SLA

Hi Kimberly / Soojin,

Quick answers from the portal team after internal review: 1) We can scope the 48h PO-ACK for orders <= $25k and for standard SKUs; we’ll provide a CSV list for initial activation. 2) The portal will persist the originating PO payload for 365 days and expose a retrieval endpoint for integrations.

We’ve scheduled the mapping call for 5/18 at 10:30am PT. Link: https://meet.example.com/portal-mapping-0518

Two asks for the call: please have the final redline summary ready (one-pager) and a shared spreadsheet that maps Redwood field names to Ariba attributes (we reviewed your template but will populate expected party IDs on the call).

Thanks — looking forward to closing this.

—ProcurePlus PMO

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: ProcurePlus PMO <pmo@procureplus.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Susan Miller <susan.miller@crescentmedical.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA + Order Form — portal mapping + PO-ack SLA

Thanks team — great alignment on the call. Action items I’ll own and owners noted:

- Kimberly: finalize one-page amendment language for 48h PO-ACK exception (scope: <= $25k, SKU whitelist). Deliverable: amendment PDF by COB 5/19.
- Marissa: prepare DocuSign envelope and link to HubSpot deal D-10924; include MSA amendment + Order Form with tracked acceptance. Deliverable: DocuSign ready 5/20.
- Soojin/Integration: import the portal-provided CSV and finalize field mapping spreadsheet; update our onboarding playbook with the 365d PO-payload persistence requirement. Deliverable: finished mapping sheet 5/19 11am PT.

Attachments uploaded to shared drive and flagged on the HubSpot timeline. If Crescent can sign the amendment quickly we’ll complete Ariba registration in the next 72 hours.

Thanks,
Soojin
